No. 2088/33– WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER, 12, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT)
ACT, No. 28 of 1964 (Chapter 460)
Notice Under Section 7
My Ref. No.: VSW/DS/LB/ACQ/ROAD
Ministry of Lands & Parliamentary Reforms Ref No.: 4-3/11/2017/UD/387.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire following lands which are required for public purpose:- Description of the land for servitude to be acquired: Lot No. 01-41 (41 Lots) allotments in extent of about 2.6227 Hectares of the land in Preliminary plan No. Ya. 2903 and dated 29.07.2018, prepared by Senior Superintendent of Surveys of Jaffna on behalf of Surveyor General, situated in the villages called Navali South, Navali East, and Anaicottai, in the Grama Niladhari Divisions are J/136 Navali South. J/135 Navali East, and J/133 Anaicottai in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Valikamam South West in the Jaffna District Northernn Province.

All persons interested in the aforesaid Land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Valikamam South West Divisional Secretariat on 03rd October 2018 at 9.00 a. m. And are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before 19.09.2018 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
All deeds and documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry.
Divisional Secretary, Valikamam South West.
